description: XSUAA security descriptor for the CAP Sales Order service

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SalesProcessor
scopes.description: Create and update own sales orders

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SalesManager
scopes.description: Full CRUD + submit, confirm delivery, and logical delete

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.SalesAuditor
scopes.description: Read-only access to all orders and analytics

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.CatalogReader
scopes.description: Read master and reference data (products, partners, org)

role-templates.name: SalesProcessor
role-templates.description: Sales order processor — create and update orders

role-templates.name: SalesManager
role-templates.description: Sales manager — full access including domain actions

role-templates.name: CatalogReader
role-templates.description: Reference data reader — F4 helpers and catalog browsing

role-templates.name: AnalyticsReader
role-templates.description: Analytics dashboard reader — SAC and Datasphere

role-collections.name: Sales_Auditor
role-collections.description: Assign to auditors and compliance roles
